description: This file is a PHP class defining an OpenCart admin dashboard controller for a chart extension. It includes methods for rendering the chart configuration page, saving settings, generating chart data, and displaying the chart view. It interacts with models, views, and session data to facilitate chart management within the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard chart extension in the OpenCart admin panel, handling configuration display, saving settings, and providing chart data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the chart configuration form page with necessary data and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of chart extension settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for displaying the dashboard chart information.

methods.name: chart
methods.description: Provides JSON data for chart rendering based on selected range ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year').
